description: This file defines a React functional component 'IosKeyboardClose' that manages the visibility and focus of a close button for the iOS keyboard within a React Native web application. It uses hooks to listen to native mobile keyboard events and DOM focus events, and conditionally renders a button with an icon.

methods.name: IosKeyboardClose
methods.description: React functional component that renders a keyboard close button, visible only when the keyboard is shown and not focused in the super editor.
